CITY OF SOUTH PASADENA
  CITY COUNCIL CLOSED SESSION
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA

  Emergency Operations Center (EOC)
  South Pasadena Fire Department
  817 Mound Avenue, South Pasadena, CA 91030

  Wednesday, August 19, 2020, at 6:15 p.m.

  NOTICE ON PUBLIC PARTICIPATION & ACCESSIBILITY

 Pursuant to Section 3 of Executive Order N-29-20, issued by Governor Newsom on
 March 17, 2020, the regular Closed Session Meeting of the City Council for August 19, 2020
 will be conducted remotely and held by video conference.

 Please be advised that pursuant to the Executive Order, and to ensure the health and safety
 of the public by limiting human contact that could spread the COVID-19 virus, the
 Emergency Operations Center will not be open for the meeting. Council Members will be
 participating remotely and will not be physically present.

 If you would like to comment on a Closed Session item, members of the public may submit
 their comments in writing for City Council consideration, by emailing them to:
 ccpubliccomment@southpasadenaca.gov. Public Comments must be received by 12
 p.m., August 19, 2020 to ensure adequate time to compile and post. Public Comment
 portion of the email is limited to 250 words. Please make sure to indicate: 1) your name; 2)
 what agenda item you are submitting public comment on, or if it is a general public comment;
 and/or 3) if you request for your public comment to be read at the meeting prior to the City
 Council recessing to Closed Session.

CALL TO ORDER:  Mayor Robert S. Joe.
ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Michael A. Cacciotti, Marina
  Khubesrian, M.D, and Richard D. Schneider, M.D; Mayor
  Pro Tem Diana Mahmud and Mayor Robert S. Joe.
 PUBLIC COMMENT PERIOD FOR CLOSED SESSION ITEMS ONLY
 The City Council welcomes public input. If you would like to comment on a Closed Session
 item, members of the public may submit their comments in writing for City Council
 consideration, by emailing them to: ccpubliccomment@southpasadenaca.gov. Public
 Comments must be received by 12 p.m., August 19, 2020 to ensure adequate time to compile

 CLOSED SESSION AGENDA ITEMS

A. LABOR NEGOTIATIONS
  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR, Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957.6

  Conference with Labor Negotiators regarding labor negotiations with the following groups:
  - Unrepresented Management Employees
  - South Pasadena Police Officers’ Association
  - South Pasadena Firefighters’ Association
  - South Pasadena Public Service Employees’ Association
  - South Pasadena Public Service Part Time Employees’ Association

  City Negotiators: City Manager Stephanie DeWolfe; Interim Human Resources Manager
  Michael Casalou; Terri Highsmith, City Attorney

B. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL—ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(2)
  Significant Exposure: A point has been reached where, in the opinion of the legislative
  body of the local agency on the advice of its legal counsel, based on existing facts and
  circumstances, there is a significant exposure to litigation against the local agency.

  Number of cases: 1

C. Initiation of Litigation
  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL—Initiation of Litigation, Pursuant to
  Government Code Section 54956.9(d)(4):

  Number of Potential Cases: 1

 I declare under penalty of perjury that I posted this notice of agenda on the bulletin board in the courtyard of
 City Hall at 1414 Mission Street, South Pasadena, CA 91030, and on the City’s website as required by law.
